answer: Problem: cheap fresh keys let one operator harvest many epoch shares. Mechanism: a new identity climbs a 7-rung ledge of stake shelves (18, 27, 40, 60, 90, 135, 202 POA); between rungs it idles 11h in a transfer-locked canyon and posts a 24-bit pigment (sha256(pubkey||salt||log_root)[:3]) to a 14-day bloom. Cost: 202 POA plus ~66h lock, blocking an 8000-key farm. Verification: peers recompute each pigment from the log and drop skipped idles or reused stamps. Failure: pigment collision slashes 48% to reporters and freezes it 5 epochs; a skipped canyon resets the ledge to rung 1 and burns 12%.
